Tile Program - IR - Optimized IR - Source - Executable
Stage 1 Parser: Python DSL - Python AST - TileLang AST
Stage 2 IR Builder: AST - TVM TIR IRModule + PrimFunc + TileOperators
Stage 3 Optimization: LayoutInference + LowerTileOp + Pipeline + WarpSpec + Vectorize
Stage 4 Codegen: CUDA C++ / HIP / CuTeDSL / LLVM IR + tl_templates headers
Stage 5 Runtime: nvcc/hipcc compile - host wrapper - PyTorch tensor launch - cache reuse
Example: T.Pipelined K-loop - cp_async pipeline - gemm_ss - copy fragment to global C
Design Position: Between Triton and CUTLASS
Dataflow-centric tiles + explicit scheduling + automated layout inference
Thread binding - Memory layout - Tensorization - Pipelining
User writes dataflow; compiler automates schedule or user annotates primitives
Design Position (controllable fused-kernel DSL on TVM - bridge Triton ease and CUTLASS perf)
Tiles as first-class objects - explicit memory hierarchy - automated layout inference - multi-vendor backends
